purpose: Prove the system degrades safely (never fails open on an authorization-sensitive action, never simply errors out to the customer) when the LLM and/or the fraud model are unavailable.

synthetic_input.customer_message: No reconozco una compra de $8,000 ARS.

missing_information: Model-generated risk score (fraud model unavailable for this run)
LLM-generated explanation (LLM unavailable for this run)
expected_ai_behavior: On LLM timeout, fall back to a deterministic intent-classification path (rule/keyword-based) rather than hanging or crashing; do not skip risk assessment.
expected_policy_behavior: On fraud-model unavailability, fall back to the logistic-regression/rules baseline and flag the decision record model_degraded=true; the policy engine still runs in full using whatever evidence is available; if the case cannot be confidently resolved without the LLM's explanation-generation step, escalate to a human rather than returning no answer.
expected_human_involvement: likely required, since automated explanation/next-best-question generation is degraded
prohibited_outcome: The system returns an unhandled error to the customer; OR a financial/protective action executes without risk assessment having run at all; OR the degradation is not recorded on the decision.
